name: macos-native-apps
description: Read and act on Mac Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Notes, and Music via AppleScript.
long_description: Wraps the [macos-native-mcp](https://github.com/mark-oskin/MacOS-mcp) server. Tools are grouped by prefix: `mail_*`, `calendar_*`, `reminders_*`, `notes_*`, `itunes_*`, and `macos_launch`. Mutating tools (send mail, create events, delete reminders) take real action — set the **Dry run** option to `1` to stub them while testing. Requires `uv` (`brew install uv`) and macOS Automation permissions for the apps you want to control.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Set to '1' to stub all mutating tools (mail_send, calendar/reminders/notes create, itunes_play_*). Read-only tools still execute. Leave as '0' for normal operation.
